text_edits.replacement_html: 두 경우 모두 iss 값을 [RFC9207]에 따라 평가해야 합니다(MUST).¶
text_edits.source_text: In both cases, the iss value MUST be evaluated according to [RFC9207].

text_edits.replacement_html: 인가 응답은 암호화되지 않은 네트워크 연결로 전송해서는 안 됩니다(MUST NOT). 이를 위해 authorization server는 http scheme을 사용하는 redirection URI를 허용해서는 안 됩니다(MUST NOT). 이 redirection URI 제한은 7.3절([RFC8252])에서 설명하는 loopback interface redirection을 사용하는 native client에는 적용되지 않습니다.¶
text_edits.source_text:
Authorization responses MUST NOT be transmitted over unencrypted network
connections. To this end, authorization servers MUST NOT allow redirection URIs that use the http scheme except for native clients that use loopback interface redirection as
described in Section 7.3 of [ RFC8252 ] . ¶
text_edits.evidence: AI source comparison: both MUST NOT requirements retain force; the prohibition explicitly applies to http-scheme redirection URIs, and only native clients using RFC8252 section 7.3 loopback interface redirection are excepted. All original English atoms, references and normative subtrees remain intact.

text_edits.source_text:
MUST validate the nonce in the ID Token obtained from the token endpoint,
 even if another ID Token was obtained from the authorization response

text_edits.evidence: AI source comparison: the client MUST validate the nonce in the token-endpoint ID Token even when the authorization response also supplied an ID Token. The other-token exception is not introduced; English terms, example, normative force and link remain exact.

text_edits.replacement_html: 해당 검사가 성공할 때까지는 모든 token(ID Token과 access token)을 무시하고, 다른 어떤 목적으로도 사용해서는 안 됩니다(MUST).¶
text_edits.source_text:
MUST ensure that, unless and until that check succeeds, all tokens (ID
